strands.title: Physical and psychological demands of performance
Factors influencing participation in physical activity

outcomes.title: Stages of skill learning
outcomes.requirement: Describe the stages through which skill learning progresses.
content: Beginner, intermediate and advanced stages.
outcomes.officialText: describe the stages of skill learning

outcomes.title: Factors influencing skill learning
outcomes.requirement: Investigate how practice and feedback influence skill acquisition.
content: Feedback and practice.
Whole, part, variable, fixed, massed, distributed and random practice.
outcomes.officialText: investigate factors influencing skill learning

outcomes.title: Designing effective practice
outcomes.requirement: Design sessions and schedules using principles of effective practice for a selected activity.
content: Variety, progressive, specific, measurable, achievable, realistic, time, exciting, challenging and recorded.
outcomes.officialText: design effective schedules and practice sessions underpinned by principles for pursuit of performance in a selected area

outcomes.title: Evaluating effective practice
outcomes.requirement: Evaluate the contribution of effective-practice principles.
content: Evaluate the principles shared with outcome S1.03, rather than only naming them.
outcomes.officialText: evaluate the principles of effective practice

outcomes.title: Sport skills and decisions
outcomes.requirement: Demonstrate skills and tactical decisions across varied physical activities.
content: Refinement of skill and technique; application of tactics and decision making.
Gross, fine, open, closed, discrete, serial, continuous, internally paced and externally paced skills.
outcomes.officialText: demonstrate sport skills, tactical awareness/decision making in varied physical activities

outcomes.title: Characteristics of skilled performance
outcomes.requirement: Identify observable characteristics of skilled performance.
content: Kinaesthetic awareness, anticipation, consistency and accuracy of movement or technique.
outcomes.officialText: identify the characteristics of a skilled performance

outcomes.title: Skill and ability
outcomes.requirement: Discuss how learned skill differs from ability.
content: Skill and ability, including their relationship in learning and performance.
outcomes.officialText: discuss the difference between skill and ability

outcomes.title: Critical analysis of skill
outcomes.requirement: Analyse skill performance critically to identify and justify improvements.
content: Newton's first, second and third laws.
Skill-analysis checklists, coaching points, video-analysis software and model performers.
Economy of movement and creative use of skill.
outcomes.officialText: analyse the performance of skills including a critical analysis for improvement

outcomes.title: Aesthetic and artistic movement
outcomes.requirement: Appraise and compare aesthetic and artistic criteria in movement.
content: Create and participate in a group performance.
Aesthetic and artistic criteria across different activities.
Methods for analysing choreography.
outcomes.officialText: appraise and compare aesthetic and artistic criteria in movement

outcomes.title: Body responses to physical activity
outcomes.requirement: Investigate physiological responses to participation in physical activity.
content: Functions and roles of the cardiovascular and respiratory systems.
Measure and monitor heart rate, breathing and body temperature.
outcomes.officialText: investigate the body’s response to physical activity participation

outcomes.title: Physical activity across life stages
outcomes.requirement: Assess participation in physical activity across the life course.
content: Infancy, childhood, adolescence, adulthood and older adulthood.
Physical-health, mental-health, social and economic benefits at different stages.
outcomes.officialText: assess being physically active across the life stages

outcomes.title: Fitness components, assessment and methods
outcomes.requirement: Apply fitness components to the demands of physical-activity performance.
content: Health-related and performance-related fitness and their relevance to activities.
Appropriate fitness tests, their validity and reliability.
Continuous, interval, fartlek, circuit, resistance, plyometric and stretching methods.
outcomes.officialText: apply the components of fitness in terms of physical activity performance

outcomes.title: Training principles and FITT
outcomes.requirement: Apply principles of training to pursue optimum performance.
content: Readiness, specificity, progressive overload, rest, recovery, reversibility and tedium.
FITT: frequency, intensity, time and type.
outcomes.officialText: apply principles of training to achieve optimum performance

outcomes.title: Recovery, overtraining and periodisation
outcomes.requirement: Discuss recovery strategies and apply periodisation in programme design.
content: Recovery strategies and overtraining.
Role and application of periodisation.
Integrating recovery and periodisation into training.
outcomes.officialText: discuss recovery strategies and apply principles of periodisation in training programme design

outcomes.title: Psychological preparedness and assessment
outcomes.requirement: Analyse psychological factors affecting practice and performance.
content: Confidence, anxiety, motivation and concentration.
Self-assessment, observation, interviews and questionnaires.
outcomes.officialText: analyse psychological preparedness in relation to factors that impact practice and performance

outcomes.title: Psychological strategies and feedback
outcomes.requirement: Evaluate psychological strategies and feedback before, during and after participation.
content: Goal setting, self-talk, thought stopping, visualisation, relaxation and performance routines, including benefits and drawbacks.
Intrinsic, extrinsic, knowledge of results, knowledge of performance, concurrent, terminal, positive and negative feedback.
outcomes.officialText: evaluate strategies to enhance psychological factors before, during and after participation including types of feedback

outcomes.title: Psychological action plans
outcomes.requirement: Investigate personal action plans grounded in psychological principles.
content: Use assessment data for confidence, concentration, motivation and anxiety.
Select suitable strategies before, during and after physical activity.
outcomes.officialText: investigate the use of personal action plans underpinned by psychological principles to support a positive psychological disposition before, during, and after physical activity

outcomes.title: Nutrition and physical performance
outcomes.requirement: Examine how nutrition supports performance.
content: Macronutrients, micronutrients and hydration.
Nutrient timing for performance and recovery; nutritional planning.
Roles, benefits and challenges of caffeine, creatine, nitrate, beta-alanine and sodium bicarbonate supplements.
outcomes.officialText: examine the role of nutrition in supporting physical performance

outcomes.title: Energy systems
outcomes.requirement: Analyse the role and relative contribution of energy systems during activity.
content: ATP-PC/alactic, anaerobic lactic and aerobic/oxidative systems.
Duration, intensity, fuel source, by-products and activity type.
outcomes.officialText: analyse the role and relative contribution of the human body energy systems during performance

outcomes.title: Muscular and skeletal systems in movement
outcomes.requirement: Recognise how muscular and skeletal systems support human movement.
content: Relevant muscle groups, bones and joint actions.
Muscular and skeletal functions in movement.
Planes and axes in anatomical movement.
outcomes.officialText: recognise the role of the muscular and skeletal systems in human movement

outcomes.title: Planning for optimum performance
outcomes.requirement: Analyse the factors and evidence used to plan for optimum performance.
content: Factors affecting performance; performance analysis; goals; evidence-based improvement planning; programme effectiveness; communication.
outcomes.officialText: analyse factors in planning for an optimum performance in physical activity

outcomes.title: High-performance sport in Ireland
outcomes.requirement: Analyse provision and support for high-performance sport in Ireland.
content: Pathways to high performance; underage player-development programmes.
Sport Ireland and national governing bodies at local, national and international levels.
outcomes.officialText: analyse the provision and support for high performance sport in Ireland

outcomes.title: Safe practice and organisation
outcomes.requirement: Examine safe approaches to participation, performance and activity organisation.
content: Rules and regulations; safety regulations.
Warm-up and cool-down, including injury prevention.
Safe use and maintenance of attire, facilities and equipment.
outcomes.officialText: examine safe practice approaches to performance and the organisation of physical activity

outcomes.title: Structures, tactics and composition
outcomes.requirement: Apply structures, tactics and compositional elements across physical activities.
content: Structures, tactics and composition used to outperform opponents, control situations or express creativity.
outcomes.officialText: apply structures, tactics and compositional elements in a range of physical activities

outcomes.title: Officiating
outcomes.requirement: Describe the knowledge, preparation and interpersonal demands of officiating.
content: Knowledge, physical fitness, psychological readiness, attire and equipment.
Effective-official characteristics, communication styles and conflict management.
outcomes.officialText: describe the requirements of officiating

outcomes.title: Coaches and choreographers
outcomes.requirement: Explore how coaches and choreographers guide performance and reflection.
content: Physical, personal and technical knowledge.
Guidance towards optimum performance.
Strategies supporting ongoing performer reflection.
outcomes.officialText: explore the role of coaches/choreographers

outcomes.title: Ethical practice
outcomes.requirement: Examine ethical principles and factors influencing ethical practice in sport.
content: Integrity, respect, fairness, equity and codes of ethics.
Sportsmanship, gamesmanship and their relationship to participation.
outcomes.officialText: examine the principles of ethical practice sport and key factors impacting on ethical practice in sport

outcomes.title: Performance-enhancing drugs and regulation
outcomes.requirement: Discuss performance-enhancing drugs and doping regulation.
content: Drug categories; implications for performer and sport.
Irish anti-doping rules and enforcement.
Therapeutic use exemptions.
outcomes.officialText: discuss performance-enhancing drugs in sport and doping regulations

outcomes.title: Technology in physical activity
outcomes.requirement: Discuss the effects of technological developments on physical activity.
content: Impacts on performers, coaches/choreographers, officials and spectators.
Optimising performance and personal use of technology.
outcomes.officialText: discuss the impact of technological developments in physical activity

outcomes.title: Media, body image and sponsorship
outcomes.requirement: Appreciate how media and sponsorship influence physical activity and sport.
content: Media coverage and participation, including different gender groups.
Body-image portrayals and participation.
Sport-related sponsorship messages.
Strategies to improve media coverage.
outcomes.officialText: appreciate the role of the media and sponsorship on physical activity and sport

outcomes.title: Access, inclusion and lifelong participation
outcomes.requirement: Examine factors affecting access, inclusion, participation and performance throughout life.
content: Participation barriers and supports.
Measuring and tracking activity participation.
Promotion, lifestyle activity, and cultural attitudes, values and traditions.
outcomes.officialText: examine factors that influence access to, inclusion, participation and performance in physical activity and how they impact lifelong participation.

outcomes.title: Evaluating physical-activity promotion
outcomes.requirement: Evaluate strategies used to promote physical activity.
content: Gender stereotyping and adapted physical activity.
Tracked participation data and strategies addressing group imbalances.
Barriers and supports; school-community pathways; mass-participation events.
outcomes.officialText: evaluate strategies related to physical activity promotion

outcomes.title: Learning through physical activity
outcomes.requirement: Participate in a broad range of activities and connect movement with theory.
content: Skill and technique; tactical/compositional components; fitness demands; psychological preparedness; nutrition.
Focus on one or two areas while engaging with a broad range; regular active participation; progression and reflection.

outcomes.title: Physical Education Project capabilities
outcomes.requirement: Demonstrate planning, engagement, skill and analysis, evaluation and communication in the project.
content: Pages 22–24 of the PDF: assessment structure and brief-led project process.
Planning; engagement; skill proficiency and analysis; evaluation; communication.
Annual SEC brief controls activity/theme selection and reporting details.
